components.label: Caller
components.sublabel: Supplies input and retry options.

components.label: pRetry controller
components.sublabel: Owns attemptNumber, retriesConsumed, startTime, and the loop.

components.label: Caller-provided input
components.sublabel: Runs one attempt; receives attemptNumber.

components.label: AbortError
components.sublabel: Operation can use it to stop retries and preserve originalError.

components.label: Failure controller
components.sublabel: Normalizes errors; computes retries left, remaining retry time, and delay.

components.label: shouldConsumeRetry
components.sublabel: First hook: decides whether this failure consumes retry budget.

components.label: onFailedAttempt
components.sublabel: Second hook: observes the frozen failure context.

components.label: shouldRetry
components.sublabel: Third hook: false rejects; true permits the next attempt.

components.label: Backoff timer
components.sublabel: Waits only when a retry is consumed; delay is capped by maxTimeout and remaining maxRetryTime.

components.label: AbortSignal
components.sublabel: Controller checks it around attempts; delay listens once and clears its timer.

components.label: Caller promise outcome
components.sublabel: Successful value returns, or the last/original error rejects.
